placements.role: Provides operating memory packaging and testing services and is expanding future fan-out panel-level packaging capacity.

role_evidence.claim: Powertech's November 2025 investor conference says packaging, testing and module assembly are operating services and separately identifies FOPLP expansion as a future capacity plan.

business_summary: Powertech Technology Inc. is a TWSE-listed packaging and test specialist whose operating business is memory packaging, testing and module assembly. Its relevance to this chain is narrower and more specific than the large OSATs': it is the memory-packaging step rather than the logic one.

exposure_summary.narrative: One ACTIVE placement, on advanced-packaging (position 7, CHOKE_POINT, heat EMERGING), VERIFIED from Powertech's own November 2025 investor conference. The mapping's role statement draws a distinction worth preserving: packaging, testing and module assembly are named as operating services, while fan-out panel-level packaging is identified separately as a future capacity plan. The AI-relevant part of this placement is the plan, not the operating line.

crowdedness_caveats: The advanced-packaging link's heat verdict is EMERGING with crowdedness 55, the least crowded link this batch touches (data/chains/ai-infrastructure.json).
No price, no 52-week range, no coverage reading and no ownership reading exist for this listing on disk, so crowdedness could not be measured for it at all.

The un-crowded reading on a smaller Taiwanese packager is partly a listing artifact: a TWSE-only line with no ADR is under-covered by Western analysts whatever its business is doing, which is a reason to be careful with the unmappedness argument rather than encouraged by it.
No valuation multiple is computed anywhere on this profile, so this file contains no basis for a priced-in judgement.

catalysts.claim: Powertech's own November 2025 investor conference names packaging, testing and module assembly as operating services and separately identifies fan-out panel-level packaging expansion as a future capacity plan, which is the dated basis of the placement.
Newly filled fundamentals (2026-09-01, yfinance-statements) show a CLEAN Beneish read (-2.746), a 10.85% operating margin, the strongest evidence this profile carries for the 6239.TW placement.

risks.claim: The mapping's own role statement separates operating memory packaging from a future FOPLP capacity plan. Treating the plan as current AI advanced-packaging capacity would overstate this placement, and the placement record says so itself.
No financial fact of any kind exists for this issuer in the local stores, not even a price print, so nothing on this profile can be weighed.
